description: Rent Lists, HashSets, Stacks, Queues, arrays, StringBuilders, and
  Unity yield instructions from pools with using-scoped leases so per-frame code
  allocates nothing. Use when writing an Update/FixedUpdate helper, a temporary
  buffer, a string builder, a network or serialization buffer, or a coroutine
  that yields WaitForSeconds.
